name: Seek Magic
body:
Design revelation; Level 0

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action

EFFECT

Range 60 ft.
Area cone-shaped emanation
Duration concentration, up to 1 min./level (D)
Saving Throw none; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

You detect magical auras. This functions as a detect magic spell, except as noted here.

Overload: For every runic charge overloaded into this script, you can maintain the script’s effects for 1 minute without needing to concentrate.
